correctness.rationale: The normal form follows from the complete-intersection gluing theorem; Apéry sets yield the exact Frobenius formula; a complete two-case split on multiplicity gives the effective universal lower bound; Möbius inversion in intervals of length 4^omega(m)+1 yields a coprime multiplier a=sqrt(m)+o(sqrt(m)), proving matching upper bound. Symmetry gives genus. The script checked 127 exact constructed Apéry sets and 18,625 normalized gluing lower-bound instances; computation supplements but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: This is a sharp quantitative solution for the natural three-generator special case of the minimum Frobenius/genus problem raised explicitly in the 2026 realizability paper. It applies to all multiplicities, including highly composite cases, gives leading constants two and one, an explicit effective coprimality window and lower bound, and leaves exact finite minima as a genuine further question. Neither a routine restatement of the existence theorem nor an arbitrary isolated example.
